criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: The value register is met (preflight medians 3.1, 1.0, 3.1, 0.80 to 0.86 near black) and 8 is the strongest frame. Short of the 10: 7's streaked veneer lifts it into the mid tones with the plate edge behind the dek; 4 and 5's slab laid flat as a bar chart with a small cart and a dead lower band; 1 and 9's lights a dotted line across the mast, beaded at the left; 3's grey floor in the mid tones; 6's sleeves read as crates.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One cart on 8 of 9 frames, one cold flood, amber held to what the record prints; the swivel and the 1 and 9 bookend work; 4 and 5 hold one camera. 7 sits outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: No numeral failed refutation; slide 1 throws unless 100 lights land in frame; every rejected finding honoured; all sources primary. Deductions: 5's empty OpenEvidence channel on a C-index axis suggests a missing score and 'No test is printed' is broader than the dek; 7's '(B)' is a different level in Texas statute numbering and '(2) NOT BARRED BY LAW' drops 'restricted'; 6's '$9,850,000 across all seven' is looser than c31 and c35.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the law beside it, honestly unjoined, with concrete next steps. The Regents route is weak: c45 appears only in the web edition and no frame shows the Regents have a role over OpenEvidence.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 8 to 9 land. The middle sags: 3 cuttable, 5 through another tool's study, 6 a branch, the statute only at 7.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, restrained, attributive; the neutral line is the house voice at its best; every house rule passes. Some lines narrate the drawing; 'Four hospital campuses' is flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh visuals; the editorial move neighbours no. 27 (22 days), no. 43 (4 days, the same UT REAL Health AI funding) and no. 23's exhibit on frame 5. Not a topic repeat.

one_sentence_fix: Replace frame 5's borrowed C-index bars with something from this story, UTMB's own evaluation commitments (c16, c17) or Rule 10403's agenda-only limit (c45) beside the November meeting.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Streaked veneer in the mid tones, the plate edge behind the dek, no cart or practical.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A near-black matte desk, the blotter below the dek's last line, the cart's lit screen at the frame edge as the practical.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The barrier flat and square as a bar chart, a small cart, a dead lower band (4 shares it).
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at 0.6 m on a three-quarter angle so the barrier recedes, the cart a third of the frame, the pool widened into the lower third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The lights a dotted line at mid frame across the mast, beaded at the left (9 repeats it).
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lights on a visible land band below the work surface, spread in depth so the left end opens.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A grey tiled floor in the mid tones, product shots.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A pool around the four carts, black between and in front, only the amber strips lit.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Sleeves as thick as the column's sections read as crates.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Thin clamp bands flush to the tube above a visible weld bead, long column shadows across the lower band.
